cases.scenario: An explicitly named agent-required scenario is applicable to one frozen full SHA.
must: run only the named authorized live proof under §A-ORCHESTRATION-03
record exact actor and candidate evidence under §A-SESSION-01

cases.scenario: A later change is documentation-only and satisfies the documented carry-forward rule.
must: record rule-based not_applicable or carry-forward provenance under §A-ACTIVATION-01
mustNot: launch a model for matrix completeness

cases.scenario: The candidate is not a frozen full SHA or the required environment is absent.
must: return blocked or not_run with the exact reason under §A-WAIT-01
